load_coco_panoptic_json: load COCO panoptic segmentation annotations from a JSON file into Detectron2 standard format dicts
register_coco_panoptic: register a standard COCO panoptic segmentation dataset with DatasetCatalog and MetadataCatalog for training
register_coco_panoptic_separated: register a separated COCO panoptic dataset with instance and semantic annotations merged together
merge_to_panoptic: merge detection dicts and semantic segmentation dicts into panoptic segmentation dataset dicts by file name
run_coco_panoptic_vis: run the module to load and visualize COCO panoptic segmentation dataset samples with Detectron2 Visualizer
